name: job-card
title: Job Card
description: A running task card with an eyebrow, title, live timer, progress bar, a stats row and actions, drawn with an orange border and a warm block shadow.
usage: Running job Strip mine, 3 branches of 32 41/64 blocksOres 7
notes: JobCardTimer ticks every second from startedAt (a Date.now() timestamp). Pass seconds for a fixed value, which also shows before the clock starts on the client. The file exports formatElapsed and useElapsed for your own clocks.

The card uses a container query: below 28rem the title drops to its own line and the actions go full width under the stats, so it works as a floating card on a map and in a phone column. Buttons in JobCardActions are 44px tall on phones.
